He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Siena Saints men's basketball|Siena Saints]]. ==High school career== Camper attended [[Kent County High School]], where he played quarterback and wide receiver as well as basketball. He scored 1,951 points in his high school career.{{cite news |last1=Singelais |first1=Mark |title=Camper is learning on the fly for Siena basketball |url=https://www.timesunion.com/sports/article/Camper-is-learning-on-the-fly-for-Siena-basketball-13530750.php |access-date=March 16, 2021 |work=[[Times Union (Albany)|Times Union]] |date=January 13, 2019}} As a senior, Camper averaged 28 points and 13 rebounds per game and led the Trojans to the Maryland 1A east region title.{{cite news |title=Siena signs 6'5" guard from Maryland |url=https://cbs6albany.com/sports/content/siena-signs-65-guard-from-maryland |access-date=March 16, 2021 |work=CBS6 |date=April 19, 2017}} He was twice named Bayside North Player of the Year.{{cite news |last1=Miles |first1=Travon |title=Camper credits Kent County, Bayside hoops amidst NBA draft declaration |url=https://www.wmdt.com/2020/05/camper-credits-kent-county-bayside-hoops-amidst-nba-draft-declaration/ |access-date=March 16, 2021 |work=WMDT |date=May 7, 2020}} ==College career== Camper rarely played as a freshman and averaged 6.4 points and 5.4 rebounds per game as a sophomore. He spent the offseason reworking his shot.{{cite news |last1=Kelly |first1=Michael |title=Camper key for Siena men's basketball |url=https://dailygazette.com/2019/10/20/camper-key-for-siena-men-s-basketball/ |access-date=March 16, 2021 |work=The Daily Gazette |date=October 20, 2019}} He averaged 13.7 points and 10.4 rebounds per game as a junior. Camper was named to the First Team All-MAAC. Following the season, he declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]] but opted to return.{{cite news |last1=Kelly |first1=Michael |title=Manny Camper returning to Siena men's basketball for senior season |url=https://dailygazette.com/2020/07/29/manny-camper-returning-to-siena-men-s-basketball-for-senior-season/ |access-date=March 16, 2021 |work=The Daily Gazette |date=July 29, 2020}} He earned MAAC Player of the Week honors on January 11, 2021, and March 1, 2021.{{cite news |title=Manny Camper claims MAAC Player of the Year honors |url=https://www.news10.com/sports/manny-camper-claims-maac-player-of-the-year-honors/ |access-date=March 16, 2021 |work=News 10 |date=March 10, 2021}} At the close of the 2020–21 regular season, Camper was named the [[Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|MAAC Player of the Year]].{{cite news |title=Manny Camper of Chestertown is Player of the Year in the MAAC |url=https://www.myeasternshoremd.com/kent_county_news/sports/college/manny-camper-of-chestertown-is-player-of-the-year-in-the-maac/article_3fc80618-fc15-504d-8011-2362dd8990de.html |access-date=March 15, 2021 |work=Kent County News |date=March 10, 2021}} He averaged 14.1 points, 9.7 rebounds and 3.6 assists per game. Following the season, Camper declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]], forgoing the additional year of eligibility the NCAA granted players due to the COVID-19 pandemic.{{cite news |last1=Singelais |first1=Mark |title=Manny Camper announces end to Siena basketball career, will declare for NBA Draft |url=https://www.timesunion.com/sports/article/Manny-Camper-announces-end-to-Siena-basketball-16030755.php |access-date=June 21, 2021 |work=[[Times Union (Albany)|Times Union]] |date=March 16, 2021}} ==Professional career== ===Grand Rapids Gold (2021–2022)=== After going undrafted in the [[2021 NBA draft]] Camper joined the [[Grand Rapids Gold]] after a successful tryout in October 2021.{{cite web|title=Grand Rapids Gold Announce 2021-22 Training Camp Roster|url=https://grandrapids.gleague.nba.com/news/grand-rapids-gold-announce-2021-22-training-camp-roster/|website=NBA.com|date=October 28, 2021|access-date=October 29, 2021}} ===Cariduros de Fajardo (2022)=== On April 12, 2022, Camper signed with the [[Cariduros de Fajardo]] of the BSN.{{cite tweet|author=La Guerra del BSN|number=1510700059171729418|title=#BSN OFICIAL: El delantero Manny Camper estará desde el primer día de temporada con los Cariduros de Fajardo tras llegar a un acuerdo con la franquicia. Camper fue seleccionado con el séptimo turno en el pasado sorteo de nuevo ingreso.|user=LaGuerraBSN|date=April 3, 2022|access-date=April 13, 2022}} ===Return to Grand Rapids (2022–2023)=== On November
